```{r}
# ============================================================
# Group colors
# ============================================================

group_colors <- c(
  "Alpha ON" = "#009967",
  "Alpha OFF" = "#006b99",
  "Asymmetric" = "#1b0099",
  "Non-Alpha" = "#540099",
  "Equal Bistratified" = "#950099",

)
```

```{r}
save <- here("Morphology", "Clustering")

data <- read_excel(
  here("data", "rawdata.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Reconstructions"
)

df <- data %>%
  select(
    File,
    zdepth1,
    zdepth2,
    `function`,
    monoorbi,
    somaarea,
    somadiameter,
    df,
    `2df`,
    dfdiameter,
    `2dfdiameter`,
    combineddf,
    equaldf,
    normalizeddf,
    dfpercent,
    df1vdf2,
    stratification,
    asymmetry,
    branchlengthsum,
    branchlengthn,
    convexhull,
    tips,
    zcoordinate,
    depth,
    density,
    complexity,
    stack,
    Group,
    min,
    max
  )


# ============================================================
# Feature sets
# ============================================================

feature_sets <- list(
  
  `7D` = c(
    "somadiameter",
    "equaldf",
    "stratification",
    "asymmetry",
    "convexhull",
    "tips"
  ),
  
  `7E` = c(
    "stratification",
    "somadiameter",
    "dfdiameter",
    "2dfdiameter",
    "asymmetry",
    "tips"
  ),
  
  `7F` = c(
    "zdepth1",
    "zdepth2",
    "somadiameter",
    "dfdiameter",
    "2dfdiameter",
    "asymmetry"
  ),
    
    `7G` = c(
    "stratification",
    "somadiameter",
    "convexhull",
    "monoorbi",
    "asymmetry",
    "equaldf",
    "branchlengthsum",
    "branchlengthn"

  )
)


# ============================================================
# Empty objects
# ============================================================

clustering_summary <- data.frame()
cluster_results <- list()
tsne_results <- list()


# ============================================================
# Run analysis for each feature set
# ============================================================

for (figure_name in names(feature_sets)) {

  message("\nRunning Supplemental Figure ", figure_name)

  variables <- feature_sets[[figure_name]]

  figure_save <- file.path(
    save,
    figure_name
  )

  dir.create(
    figure_save,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  analysis_df <- df %>%
    select(
      File,
      Group,
      all_of(variables)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      complete.cases(across(all_of(variables)))
    )


  clust_data <- analysis_df %>%
    select(all_of(variables)) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        everything(),
        as.numeric
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove zero-variance variables
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  variable_sd <- sapply(
    clust_data,
    sd,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  zero_variance_variables <- names(
    variable_sd[
      is.na(variable_sd) |
        variable_sd == 0
    ]
  )


  if (length(zero_variance_variables) > 0) {

    warning(
      figure_name,
      ": removing zero-variance variables: ",
      paste(
        zero_variance_variables,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )

    clust_data <- clust_data %>%
      select(
        -all_of(zero_variance_variables)
      )

    variables <- setdiff(
      variables,
      zero_variance_variables
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # PCA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pca <- prcomp(
    clust_data,
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = TRUE
  )


  variance_explained <- (
    pca$sdev^2 /
      sum(pca$sdev^2)
  ) * 100

  cumulative_variance <- cumsum(
    variance_explained
  )


  n_pcs_80 <- which(
    cumulative_variance >= 80
  )[1]


  pca_results <- as.data.frame(
    pca$x[
      ,
      seq_len(n_pcs_80),
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


  message(
    figure_name,
    ": retaining ",
    n_pcs_80,
    " PCs explaining ",
    round(
      cumulative_variance[n_pcs_80],
      2
    ),
    "% of the variance"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PCA variance table
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pca_variance_table <- data.frame(
    PC = paste0(
      "PC",
      seq_along(variance_explained)
    ),
    variance_explained = variance_explained,
    cumulative_variance = cumulative_variance,
    retained = seq_along(
      variance_explained
    ) <= n_pcs_80
  )


  write.csv(
    pca_variance_table,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_PCA_variance.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PCA loadings
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(
    pca$rotation
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "variable"
    )


  write.csv(
    pca_loadings,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_PCA_loadings.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Scree plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(
    pca,
    addlabels = TRUE,
    ylim = c(
      0,
      max(
        50,
        max(variance_explained) + 5
      )
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = n_pcs_80,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Supplemental Figure ",
        figure_name,
        ": PCA Scree Plot"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        n_pcs_80,
        " PCs explain ",
        round(
          cumulative_variance[n_pcs_80],
          1
        ),
        "% of total variance"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      figure_name,
      "_scree.pdf"
    ),
    plot = scree_plot,
    path = figure_save,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # PCA contribution plots
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (pc_number in seq_len(n_pcs_80)) {

    contribution_plot <- fviz_contrib(
      pca,
      choice = "var",
      axes = pc_number,
      xtickslab.rt = 90
    ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Supplemental Figure ",
          figure_name,
          ": Contributions to PC",
          pc_number
        )
      ) +
      theme_minimal()


    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_PC",
        pc_number,
        "_contributions.pdf"
      ),
      plot = contribution_plot,
      path = figure_save,
      width = 8,
      height = 6
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Define possible values of k
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  max_k <- min(
    10,
    nrow(pca_results) - 1
  )

  k_values <- 2:max_k


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Silhouette analysis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  distance_matrix <- dist(
    pca_results,
    method = "euclidean"
  )


  silhouette_results <- data.frame(
    k = k_values,
    average_silhouette_width = NA_real_
  )


  for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {

    current_k <- k_values[i]

    set.seed(123)

    temporary_kmeans <- kmeans(
      pca_results,
      centers = current_k,
      nstart = 50,
      iter.max = 1000
    )


    silhouette_object <- silhouette(
      temporary_kmeans$cluster,
      distance_matrix
    )


    silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width[i] <-
      mean(
        silhouette_object[, "sil_width"]
      )
  }


  silhouette_k <- silhouette_results$k[
    which.max(
      silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width
    )
  ]


  optimal_silhouette <- max(
    silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width
  )


  message(
    figure_name,
    ": silhouette selected k = ",
    silhouette_k,
    " (average width = ",
    round(
      optimal_silhouette,
      3
    ),
    ")"
  )


  write.csv(
    silhouette_results,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_silhouette_results.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Silhouette plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  silhouette_plot <- ggplot(
    silhouette_results,
    aes(
      x = k,
      y = average_silhouette_width
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = silhouette_k,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = k_values
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Supplemental Figure ",
        figure_name,
        ": Silhouette Method"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Selected k = ",
        silhouette_k
      ),
      x = "Number of clusters",
      y = "Average silhouette width"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      figure_name,
      "_silhouette.pdf"
    ),
    plot = silhouette_plot,
    path = figure_save,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gap statistic
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(123)

  gap_stat <- clusGap(
    pca_results,
    FUNcluster = kmeans,
    K.max = max_k,
    B = 500,
    nstart = 50,
    iter.max = 1000
  )


  gap_k <- maxSE(
    f = gap_stat$Tab[, "gap"],
    SE.f = gap_stat$Tab[, "SE.sim"],
    method = "firstSEmax"
  )


  selected_gap <- gap_stat$Tab[
    gap_k,
    "gap"
  ]


  message(
    figure_name,
    ": gap statistic selected k = ",
    gap_k,
    " (Gap = ",
    round(
      selected_gap,
      3
    ),
    ")"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save gap-statistic table
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  gap_table <- as.data.frame(
    gap_stat$Tab
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "k"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      k = as.integer(k),
      selected = k == gap_k
    )


  write.csv(
    gap_table,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_gap_results.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Gap-statistic plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  gap_plot <- fviz_gap_stat(
    gap_stat,
    maxSE = list(
      method = "firstSEmax"
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = gap_k,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Supplemental Figure ",
        figure_name,
        ": Gap Statistic"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Selected k = ",
        gap_k
      ),
      x = "Number of clusters",
      y = "Gap statistic"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      figure_name,
      "_gap.pdf"
    ),
    plot = gap_plot,
    path = figure_save,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Final clustering
  # Uses gap-statistic-selected k
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(123)

  final_kmeans <- kmeans(
    pca_results,
    centers = gap_k,
    nstart = 50,
    iter.max = 1000
  )


  cluster_assignments <- bind_cols(
    analysis_df %>%
      select(
        File,
        Group
      ),
    pca_results
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = factor(
        final_kmeans$cluster
      )
    )


  cluster_results[[figure_name]] <- cluster_assignments


  write.csv(
    cluster_assignments,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_cluster_assignments.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
# Stacked bar plot: group composition within each cluster
# ----------------------------------------------------------

cluster_composition <- cluster_assignments %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  count(
    cluster,
    Group,
    name = "n_cells"
  )


cluster_composition_plot <- ggplot(
  cluster_composition,
  aes(
    x = cluster,
    y = n_cells,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "Supplemental Figure ",
      figure_name,
      ": Group Composition by Cluster"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Gap-selected k = ",
      gap_k
    ),
    x = "Cluster assignment",
    y = "Number of cells",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )


print(cluster_composition_plot)


ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    figure_name,
    "_cluster_group_composition.pdf"
  ),
  plot = cluster_composition_plot,
  path = figure_save,
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster-by-group table
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  cluster_group_table <- table(
    Group = cluster_assignments$Group,
    Cluster = cluster_assignments$cluster
  )


  write.csv(
    as.data.frame.matrix(
      cluster_group_table
    ),
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_cluster_by_group.csv"
      )
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  plot_df <- cluster_assignments


  if (!"PC2" %in% names(plot_df)) {
    plot_df$PC2 <- 0
  }


  x_label <- paste0(
    "PC1 (",
    round(
      variance_explained[1],
      1
    ),
    "%)"
  )


  if (n_pcs_80 >= 2) {

    y_label <- paste0(
      "PC2 (",
      round(
        variance_explained[2],
        1
      ),
      "%)"
    )

  } else {

    y_label <- "PC2"
  }


  cluster_plot <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      color = cluster
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 6,
      stroke = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Group),
      vjust = -1.4,
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      check_overlap = FALSE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Supplemental Figure ",
        figure_name,
        ": K-means Clustering"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        n_pcs_80,
        " PCs retained; gap k = ",
        gap_k,
        "; silhouette k = ",
        silhouette_k
      ),
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      color = "Cluster"
    ) +
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 20,
      r = 20,
      b = 10,
      l = 10
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 15,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 1.5,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks.length = unit(
      0.4,
      "cm"
    ),

    axis.line = element_line(
      linewidth = 1.2,
      color = "black"
    )
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      figure_name,
      "_clusters.pdf"
    ),
    plot = cluster_plot,
    path = figure_save,
    width = 9,
    height = 7
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # t-SNE using the same retained PCA scores
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  max_valid_perplexity <- floor(
    (nrow(pca_results) - 2) / 3
  )

  perplexity_used <- min(
    10,
    max_valid_perplexity
  )

  if (perplexity_used >= 1) {

    message(
      figure_name,
      ": using t-SNE perplexity = ",
      perplexity_used
    )

    set.seed(42)

    tsne_result <- Rtsne(
      as.matrix(pca_results),
      dims = 2,
      perplexity = perplexity_used,
      max_iter = 1000,
      verbose = TRUE,
      check_duplicates = FALSE,
      pca = FALSE
    )

    tsne_coordinates <- as.data.frame(
      tsne_result$Y
    )

    colnames(tsne_coordinates) <- c(
      "tSNE1",
      "tSNE2"
    )

    tsne_df <- bind_cols(
      analysis_df %>%
        select(
          File,
          Group
        ),
      tsne_coordinates
    )

    tsne_results[[figure_name]] <- tsne_df

    write.csv(
      tsne_df,
      file.path(
        figure_save,
        paste0(
          figure_name,
          "_tSNE_coordinates.csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    tsne_plot <- ggplot(
      tsne_df,
      aes(
        x = tSNE1,
        y = tSNE2,
        fill = Group
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(
        size = 8,
        shape = 21,
        color = "black",
        stroke = 1.2
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = group_colors,
        drop = FALSE,
        na.value = "gray70"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = NULL,
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        text = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(
          t = 10,
          r = 10,
          b = 10,
          l = 10
        )
      )

    print(tsne_plot)

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_tSNE.pdf"
      ),
      plot = tsne_plot,
      path = figure_save,
      width = 8,
      height = 6,
      dpi = 300
    )

  } else {

    warning(
      figure_name,
      ": too few observations for t-SNE."
    )

    perplexity_used <- NA_integer_
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add both methods to summary
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  current_summary <- data.frame(
    figure = figure_name,
    n_cells = nrow(analysis_df),
    n_variables = ncol(clust_data),

    variables = paste(
      variables,
      collapse = "; "
    ),

    PCs_for_80_percent = n_pcs_80,

    cumulative_variance = cumulative_variance[
      n_pcs_80
    ],

    silhouette_clusters = silhouette_k,

    optimal_silhouette_width = optimal_silhouette,

    gap_clusters = gap_k,

    selected_gap = selected_gap,

    final_clusters_used = gap_k,

    final_selection_method = "Gap statistic: firstSEmax",

    tsne_perplexity = perplexity_used,

    tsne_seed = 42,

    tsne_iterations = 1000
  )


  clustering_summary <- bind_rows(
    clustering_summary,
    current_summary
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Save overall summary
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  clustering_summary,
  file.path(
    save,
    "Supplemental_Figure_7_analysis_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(clustering_summary)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# File paths
# ============================================================

save <- here("Morphology", "Clustering", "7G_with_physiology")

dir.create(
  save,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Excel file path
# ============================================================

excel_file <- here("data", "rawdata.xlsx")


# ============================================================
# Load reconstruction and physiology sheets
# ============================================================

reconstruction_data <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "Reconstructions"
)

physiology_data <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "physiology"
)


# ============================================================
# Variables used for Supplemental Figure 7G
# ============================================================

variables_7G <-c(
    "stratification",
    "somadiameter",
    "convexhull",
    "monoorbi",
    "asymmetry",
    "equaldf",
    "branchlengthsum",
    "branchlengthn"
  )


# ============================================================
# Prepare reconstruction cells
# ============================================================

reconstruction_df <- reconstruction_data %>%
  transmute(
    File = trimws(as.character(File)),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Phys = NA_character_,
    data_source = "Reconstruction",
    across(
      all_of(variables_7G),
      as.numeric
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Prepare physiology cells
# ============================================================

physiology_df <- physiology_data %>%
  transmute(
    File = trimws(as.character(File)),
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Phys = trimws(as.character(physiology)),
    data_source = "Physiology",
    across(
      all_of(variables_7G),
      as.numeric
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Combine both datasets
# ============================================================

combined_df <- bind_rows(
  reconstruction_df,
  physiology_df
) %>%
  distinct(
    File,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(
      across(
        all_of(variables_7G)
      )
    )
  )


message(
  "Reconstruction cells included: ",
  sum(combined_df$data_source == "Reconstruction")
)

message(
  "Physiology cells included: ",
  sum(combined_df$data_source == "Physiology")
)


# ============================================================
# Check which physiology cells were excluded
# ============================================================

excluded_physiology <- physiology_df %>%
  filter(
    !complete.cases(
      across(
        all_of(variables_7G)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    missing_variables = paste(
      variables_7G[
        is.na(
          c_across(
            all_of(variables_7G)
          )
        )
      ],
      collapse = ", "
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


write.csv(
  excluded_physiology,
  file.path(
    save,
    "7G_excluded_physiology_cells.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# Create clustering matrix
# ============================================================

clust_data <- combined_df %>%
  select(
    all_of(variables_7G)
  )


# Remove zero-variance variables
variable_sd <- sapply(
  clust_data,
  sd,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

zero_variance_variables <- names(
  variable_sd[
    is.na(variable_sd) |
      variable_sd == 0
  ]
)

if (length(zero_variance_variables) > 0) {

  warning(
    "Removing zero-variance variables: ",
    paste(
      zero_variance_variables,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )

  clust_data <- clust_data %>%
    select(
      -all_of(zero_variance_variables)
    )
}


# ============================================================
# PCA
# ============================================================

pca <- prcomp(
  clust_data,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

variance_explained <- (
  pca$sdev^2 /
    sum(pca$sdev^2)
) * 100

cumulative_variance <- cumsum(
  variance_explained
)

n_pcs_80 <- which(
  cumulative_variance >= 80
)[1]

pca_results <- as.data.frame(
  pca$x[
    ,
    seq_len(n_pcs_80),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

message(
  "Using ",
  n_pcs_80,
  " PCs explaining ",
  round(
    cumulative_variance[n_pcs_80],
    2
  ),
  "% of total variance."
)

 # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Define possible values of k
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  max_k <- min(
    10,
    nrow(pca_results) - 1
  )

  k_values <- 2:max_k

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Silhouette analysis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  distance_matrix <- dist(
    pca_results,
    method = "euclidean"
  )


  silhouette_results <- data.frame(
    k = k_values,
    average_silhouette_width = NA_real_
  )


  for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {

    current_k <- k_values[i]

    set.seed(123)

    temporary_kmeans <- kmeans(
      pca_results,
      centers = current_k,
      nstart = 50,
      iter.max = 1000
    )


    silhouette_object <- silhouette(
      temporary_kmeans$cluster,
      distance_matrix
    )


    silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width[i] <-
      mean(
        silhouette_object[, "sil_width"]
      )
  }


  silhouette_k <- silhouette_results$k[
    which.max(
      silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width
    )
  ]


  optimal_silhouette <- max(
    silhouette_results$average_silhouette_width
  )


  message(
    figure_name,
    ": silhouette selected k = ",
    silhouette_k,
    " (average width = ",
    round(
      optimal_silhouette,
      3
    ),
    ")"
  )


  write.csv(
    silhouette_results,
    file.path(
      figure_save,
      paste0(
        figure_name,
        "_silhouette_results.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Silhouette plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  silhouette_plot <- ggplot(
    silhouette_results,
    aes(
      x = k,
      y = average_silhouette_width
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = silhouette_k,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = k_values
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Supplemental Figure ",
        figure_name,
        ": Silhouette Method"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Selected k = ",
        silhouette_k
      ),
      x = "Number of clusters",
      y = "Average silhouette width"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(
      figure_name,
      "_silhouette.pdf"
    ),
    plot = silhouette_plot,
    path = figure_save,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )



# ============================================================
# Final k-means clustering
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

final_kmeans <- kmeans(
  pca_results,
  centers = gap_k,
  nstart = 50,
  iter.max = 1000
)

cluster_assignments <- bind_cols(
  combined_df %>%
    select(
      File,
      Group,
      Phys,
      data_source
    ),
  pca_results
) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(
      final_kmeans$cluster
    )
  )


write.csv(
  cluster_assignments,
  file.path(
    save,
    "7G_cluster_assignments_with_physiology.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# Stacked bar graph: group composition within each cluster
# ============================================================

group_colors <- c(
  "Alpha ON" = "#009967",
  "Alpha OFF" = "#006b99",
  "Asymmetric" = "#1b0099",
  "Non-Alpha" = "#540099",
  "Equal Bistratified" = "#950099",
  "Unequal Bistratified" = "#990032"
)

cluster_composition <- cluster_assignments %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group)
  ) %>%
  count(
    cluster,
    Group,
    name = "n_cells"
  )

composition_plot <- ggplot(
  cluster_composition,
  aes(
    x = cluster,
    y = n_cells,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Cluster assignment",
    y = "Number of cells",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "7G_cluster_group_composition.pdf",
  plot = composition_plot,
  path = save,
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)


# ============================================================
# Run t-SNE on the combined PCA results
# ============================================================

max_valid_perplexity <- floor(
  (nrow(pca_results) - 2) / 3
)

perplexity_used <- min(
  10,
  max_valid_perplexity
)

if (perplexity_used < 1) {
  stop("Not enough complete observations to run t-SNE.")
}

set.seed(42)

tsne_result <- Rtsne(
  as.matrix(pca_results),
  dims = 2,
  perplexity = perplexity_used,
  max_iter = 1000,
  verbose = TRUE,
  check_duplicates = FALSE,
  pca = FALSE
)

tsne_df <- bind_cols(
  cluster_assignments,
  data.frame(
    tSNE1 = tsne_result$Y[, 1],
    tSNE2 = tsne_result$Y[, 2]
  )
)


write.csv(
  tsne_df,
  file.path(
    save,
    "7G_tSNE_coordinates_with_physiology.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# Physiology cells to highlight in each separate plot
# ============================================================

highlight_lists <- list(
  "Alpha ON" = c(
    "NL0176", "NL0118", "NL0161", "NL0175"
  ),

  "Alpha OFF" = c(
    "NL0113", "NL0183"
  ),

  "Non-Alpha" = c(
    "NL0170"
  ),

  "Equal Bistratified" = c(
    "NL0109", "NL0159", "NL0163",
    "NL0171", "NL0182", "NL0184"
  ),

  "Unequal Bistratified" = c(
    "NL0110", "NL0157", "NL0162", "NL0164",
    "NL0168", "NL0169", "NL0172", "NL0173",
    "NL0160", "NL0114", "NL0181"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Make one t-SNE plot per group
# ============================================================

for (grp in names(highlight_lists)) {

  cells_to_highlight <- trimws(highlight_lists[[grp]])
  highlight_color <- unname(group_colors[grp])

  # Mark only the selected cells for this plot
  plot_df <- tsne_df %>%
    mutate(
      File = trimws(as.character(File)),
      Highlight = File %in% cells_to_highlight
    )

  highlighted_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(Highlight)

  # Warn if any requested cells were excluded or not found
  missing_cells <- setdiff(
    cells_to_highlight,
    plot_df$File
  )

  if (length(missing_cells) > 0) {
    warning(
      grp,
      ": these cells were not included in the final 7G t-SNE: ",
      paste(missing_cells, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Stop this iteration if none of the requested cells are present
  if (nrow(highlighted_df) == 0) {
    warning(
      grp,
      ": no highlighted cells were available, so no plot was saved."
    )
    next
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = tSNE1,
      y = tSNE2
    )
  ) +

    # All non-highlighted cells shown faintly by morphological group
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>%
        filter(!Highlight),
      aes(fill = Group),
      shape = 21,
      size = 8,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.2,
      alpha = 0.15
    ) +

    # Selected physiology cells for this group
    geom_point(
      data = highlighted_df,
      shape = 21,
      size = 10,
      fill = highlight_color,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 1.5,
      alpha = 1
    ) +

    # Physiology labels for selected cells
    geom_text_repel(
      data = highlighted_df %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Phys),
          trimws(Phys) != ""
        ),
      aes(label = Phys),
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )

  print(p)

  safe_group_name <- gsub(
    pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
    replacement = "_",
    x = grp
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      save,
      paste0(
        "7G_tSNE_highlight_",
        safe_group_name,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
